items.title: Judge's question for the GM: into the Situational tab
items.do: As the GM with no token selected, the Judged Orc Warrior damages an ally near Durgan; read where the question shows; then click Durgan's token.
items.expect: Once Durgan's HUD is up, the question moves into its Situational tab, in the tab's look (not the large bar across the HUD). With no creature selected it may first show in the HUD's middle.

items.title: The hover card: worked-out damage
items.do: Hover an area with Hazardous Terrain whose damage uses its origin's Modifier (for example a hazard of 2 + Weapon Modifier Pierce), and Aveline's Consecrated Ground.
items.expect: The damage reads as a number and its type in full and in its color ("Hazardous Terrain, 5 Pierce"), not "2 + @origin.wpn Pi"; Consecrated Ground's Guard as a number ("Guard 2 at the start of their turns").

items.title: The Encounter Log: To allies and numbered names
items.do: In a fight with two Goblin Sneaks, Sylwen's Volley hits Aveline and both Goblins; open the Encounter Log.
items.expect: Under the log, a "Damage dealt" table with a "To allies" column (Sylwen's damage to Aveline there); the Goblins are "Goblin Sneak 1" and "Goblin Sneak 2" in the log's lines and in the copied text.
